info.title: Synthea.Cli
info.description: CLI wrapper around MITRE Synthea synthetic patient generator. Downloads the latest Synthea release, manages a local JAR cache, and exposes Synthea's generation flags as first-class .NET CLI options.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI wrapper around MITRE Synthea synthetic patient generator

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Ignore cached JAR and download the newest release [default: False]

options.name: --java-path
options.description: Full path to the Java executable (defaults to 'java' on PATH)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable debug-level logging [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress info logs; show only warnings and errors [default: False]

options.name: --skip-jdk-check
options.description: Bypass the Java 17+ preflight check. Use only for custom JREs whose -version output we can't parse; otherwise fix Java first. [default: False]

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Generate synthetic health records.

Examples:
  synthea run -o ./out -p 100 --state OH --add-format CSV
  synthea run -o ./out -p 5 --state Ohio --gender F --age-range 30-40
  synthea run -o ./out -p 50000 --us-core-version 7 --fhir-version R5
  synthea run -o ./out -p 1000 --seed 42 --clinician-seed 7 --single-person-seed 9
  synthea run -o ./out --jar ~/synthea.jar --dry-run

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory where Synthea will write its output

options.name: --state
options.description: State name (e.g. 'Ohio') or two-letter USPS code (e.g. 'OH'). 2-letter codes are converted to the full name automatically. Rejects unknown names with a suggestion.

options.name: --city
options.description: City name (optional second positional arg after state)

options.name: --gender
options.description: Patient gender filter (M or F)

options.name: --age-range
options.description: Age range filter as min-max

options.name: --module-dir
options.description: Directory of custom modules

options.name: --module
options.description: Specific disease modules

options.name: --population
options.description: Number of patients to generate

options.name: --seed
options.description: Random seed for deterministic output

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to Synthea configuration file

options.name: --zip
options.description: ZIP code (requires --state)

options.name: --fhir-version
options.description: FHIR version (STU3, R4, or R5)

options.name: --initial-snapshot
options.description: Path to initial snapshot to load (-i)

options.name: --updated-snapshot
options.description: Path where updated snapshot will be written (-u)

options.name: --days-forward
options.description: Advance time from snapshot by N days (-t)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output formats to generate (FHIR, CSV, CCDA, BULKFHIR, CPCDS). Exclusive: enables only the named formats and disables all others. Use --add-format to extend Synthea defaults instead.

options.name: --add-format
options.description: Additive format to enable in addition to Synthea defaults (FHIR, CSV, CCDA, BULKFHIR, CPCDS). Repeatable. Does not disable any other format; see --format for exclusive semantics.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the java command line that would be run, then exit without running it. Useful for debugging or scripting. Does not download the JAR. [default: False]

options.name: --jar
options.description: Path to a Synthea JAR to use directly. Skips the GitHub download. Falls back to SYNTHEA_CLI_JAR_PATH env var, then ~/.synthea-cli/config.json.

options.name: --insist-checksum
options.description: Fail the run if the upstream release does not publish a .sha256 asset. [default: False]

options.name: --reference-date
options.description: Reference date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). Maps to Synthea -r YYYYMMDD.

options.name: --end-date
options.description: Simulation end date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). Maps to Synthea -e YYYYMMDD. Requires --allow-future-end if the date is beyond today.

options.name: --allow-future-end
options.description: Permit --end-date beyond today (Synthea -E). [default: False]

options.name: --clinician-seed
options.description: Random seed for clinician generation (Synthea -cs N).

options.name: --single-person-seed
options.description: Random seed for single-person generation (Synthea -ps N).

options.name: --overflow
options.description: Allow Synthea's overflow generation (-o true). Off by default; turn on for full-fidelity reruns of past results. [default: False]

options.name: --property
options.description: Set a Synthea property as KEY=VALUE (repeatable). Emitted as --KEY=VALUE. Use for properties without a first-class flag.

options.name: --us-core-version
options.description: US Core IG version to apply to FHIR export. Allowed: 3.1.1, 4, 5, 6, 7. Implies --exporter.fhir.use_us_core_ig=true.

options.name: --flexporter-mapping
options.description: Path to a Flexporter mapping file (.yaml/.json). Maps to Synthea -fm <path>.

options.name: --ig-dir
options.description: Directory of FHIR Implementation Guide resources. Maps to Synthea -ig <dir>.

options.name: --bulk-data
options.description: Emit FHIR resources as bulk-data NDJSON (--exporter.fhir.bulk_data=true). [default: False]

options.name: --java-heap
options.description: Override the auto-sized JVM heap (e.g. '4g' or '1024m'). Defaults: 2g for >=1k, 4g for >=10k, 8g for >=100k, 16g for >=1M; no flag for <1k (use JVM default).

options.name: --progress
options.description: Print a periodic 'Generated X/Y patients (Z%)…' status line to stderr while Synthea runs. Off by default; opt in for long runs. [default: False]

arguments.name: ARGS
arguments.description: Any other arguments forwarded unchanged to synthea.jar
